declared.name: the founding record declares its classes, each with its legal weight
a counted change that drops legal: medical alone
a change below the protocol (one voice of three) concludes nothing: the charter is unchanged
a version is the whole record: one stating no classes declares none
and after a drop, a version stating none declares none
a later change restores legal
two concurrent versions that differ: the pairs both list
two concurrent versions listing medical with different legal weights: neither pair is common
a version naming both decides
a version naming both that states none declares none
a reader holding only one of the two reads it
a one-seat affiliation changes its charter alone: a record change is no act against a member
an appointed member is a voice: A alone is one of two, below the protocol
and A with B is two of two
any community's record is a charter
a family's record is no charter
no founding row held: no charter
a dissolved affiliation declares nothing
an affiliation whose last seat has lapsed is dissolved (no signer): nothing
a version's own stated end, not yet reached
and reached: nothing
with no clock given, the stated end is not read

licences.name: a class declared is honoured
a class the charter does not declare is read and not honoured
a class a later amendment drops stops matching, the licence issued before it included
a licence issued after the drop names the change, and is not honoured either
a drop below the protocol changes nothing
a reader holding the older version honours the class
a reader holding the newer one does not
a version stating no classes: nothing is honoured
two versions that differ: a class one lists waits
and a class both list is honoured
until a version names both
trust_classes absent: every class the charter declares
trust_classes present: a class it does not list is not reached
trust_classes present: a class it lists
trust_classes an empty list: the edge is refused, so nothing is reached
trust_classes not sorted: the edge is refused
hop by hop: legal admitted at the first hop and not at the second
hop by hop: medical admitted at both
hop by hop: the first hop admits all, the second legal
hop by hop: the first hop admits medical only, the second all
an edge with no depth left reaches no licensor past it
a reader with no edge reaches nothing
a one-seat affiliation's change adds legal
a community's record declares its classes
and not others
a family's record declares nothing
a dissolved affiliation's licences are not honoured
a record whose stated end has passed, at the caller's instant
a charter supplied for the authority meets the one read from rows
and the classes both declare are honoured
a charter supplied for an authority that is no community held stands alone

undecided.name: a counted removal of a member of an affiliation is undecided, naming its row
a change of the record is not
